'''Ashtika''' is a NPC female student found in the Exostrider Engineering classroom in the morning at <nowiki>06:00-11:59</nowiki>, talking with [[Hoyer]]. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Hoyer:''' Hey, that's not fair.
:'''Hoyer:''' How come te guys at Rabelle College get to hog the proving grounds all the time?

==Dialogue==
:'''Hoyer:''' I don't care what anyone says, the Department of Engineering IS foundational!
:'''Hoyer:''' What are they gonna train with if we don't build their gear and weapons?
:'''Ashtika:''' Forget it. Access to the proving grounds is split between Rabelle College and... well, the rest of us.
:'''Ashtika:''' That's what happens when you're directly funded by the New Federation.
:'''Ashtika:''' We should try tag-teaming with Energy Science the next time we apply.
{{Dialogue End}}
